mintAuthority.summary: inALPHA is a non-upgradeable BoringVault on Ethereum and Plume. Shares are minted only via the enter() function, which requires authorization from a RolesAuthority contract (0x5e500500968388a13b3ff885c3eed7158a5d82ef). The current authorized Teller is TellerWithMultiAssetSupportPredicateProxy (0x20428f901a50ec69f5a2b56d313491cc686fafff) on both deployments. Vault owner is a 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe (0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982). Native issuance is assessed here; Nest's separate LayerZero OFT share route belongs in Bridge Risk and remains unresolved pending exact route addresses.

controls.evidence: Non-upgradeable BoringVault (EIP-1967 slots zero). enter() is guarded by requiresAuth; at Ethereum block 25,769,980 and Plume block 87,665,989, RolesAuthority at 0x5e500500968388a13b3ff885c3eed7158a5d82ef grants the enter capability to role 3 and the current TellerWithMultiAssetSupportPredicateProxy (0x20428f901a50ec69f5a2b56d313491cc686fafff) holds that role on both chains. The previously authored 0x6104fe10ca937a086ba7AdbD0910A4733d380cB6 address has no role and is not the inALPHA Teller.

controls.evidence: Safe API at Ethereum block 25,296,225: Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 (GnosisSafeL2 v1.3.0), threshold 3-of-6, 6 owners, no modules, no guard, nonce 151. This Safe is owner() of the BoringVault and controls the RolesAuthority. 2026-07-20 (Kimi P2 dc-2): owner() of the inALPHA BoringVault returns this Safe on both Ethereum and Plume; recorded as the explicit authority address so the control identity resolves.

review.evidence: Ethereum and Plume reads on 2026-07-14 confirmed the inALPHA vault at 0x64ab176c...b855 has direct runtime code, zero EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots, no UUPS interface, Safe owner 0xa08a0dc4...a982, and RolesAuthority 0x5e500500...82ef on both chains. The current authorized teller at 0x20428f90...fafff has identical runtime bytecode on both chains, zero EIP-1967 slots, no UUPS interface, the same Safe owner, and role 3 authorization for the vault enter() capability at Ethereum block 25,769,980 and Plume block 87,665,989; the previously authored 0x6104fe10...0cb6 address has no role. The mint-critical vault and teller implementations are therefore immutable on both tracked deployments; the Safe can still change authorization through the separately reviewed RolesAuthority control path. Evidence challenge completed 2026-07-15: Nest publishes issuer-operated hourly NAV and live vault composition, with the latest public vault-data snapshot dated 2026-07-08, but no recurring independent reconciliation of nALPHA supply to its multi-asset portfolio was found. Nest DAO LLC is a Marshall Islands DAO LLC, not a prudentially supervised fund issuer. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the owner Safe can change authorization without an independent timelock, and issuer-operated NAV data is not independent whole-supply reconciliation or prudential supervision. Wave 2 external research reviewed 2026-08-15: Nest's live positions feed now returns portfolio values, NAV, aggregate total supply, and supply by chain across all current issuance routes, establishing continuous whole-supply reconciliation under the rubric while remaining issuer-operated rather than prudentially supervised.
